pages.title: Neutronium Singularity
pages.text: Neutronium is already matter at nuclear density. Compressed beyond even that, it is close to becoming a true black hole. The point is perfectly black and unthinkably heavy, and space seems to dip toward it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutronium is what a neutron star is made of. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor brought it close to the Schwarzschild radius, and it collapsed into a single point.
